QuestInfo.name: Toy Black Knight
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Ludibrium Clocktower and see if there's another gate there.\nYou're most likely to find one on #m220011000#, but the #o3230305# monsters there are Lv. 67. Best not to go until you're ready.\n
QuestInfo.2: You met an arrogant man in black by the gate on #m220011000#.
QuestInfo.0: Starling has appeared before you again. Time to find out why she tricked you!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to the Ill-Fated quest\n

0.0: I told you we'd meet again, didn't I?\r\n#L0##bYou! Spiruna never sent out any invitations! What's going on?#l\n#k
0.1: It was all just a misunderstanding, I'm sure.\r\n#L0##bI thought Spiruna was going to give me a gift! Do you know how heartbroken I was when she didn't have a gift for me? DO YOU?!#l\n#k
0.2: To be honest, I can't remember exactly what I said. I was too busy thinking about more important things.\r\n#L0##bFine, whatever! Look, do you know a girl named Lora? She says you told her about me.#l\n#k
0.3: What are you going on about now...? Look, if you really want a gift, I can arrange something...

yes.0: I thought that would get your attention. Go to Ludibrium Clocktower and meet the man in black at #r#m220011000##k. Be careful, though. The monsters there are #bLevel 67#k.

no.0: Aren't adventurers supposed to say 'Yes' to adventure? Talk to me again if you change your mind.

1.0: Ah? Who're you, twerp? Shoo. This isn't a place for a kid like you.

npc.0: Be careful! The monsters at #m220011000# are Lv. 67. You should probably gain a few levels before you try going in yourself.
